title: dipteracanthus ciliosus
intro: Dipteracanthus ciliosus, commonly known as the Firecracker Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Dipteracanthus ciliosus include wound healing, antiparasitic, and antiviral activities.
